registryBasis: The official Katihar district land-record service page identifies the local district administration's land-record service, and the official Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms / Directorate of Land Records and Survey pages identify Bhu-Naksha as the state cadastral-map service. The live BhuNaksha hierarchy returned Katihar district (code 10), Katihar subdivision/circle, and Katihar mauza (code 0062). This establishes official custodian/service evidence, not citywide completeness or title/ownership information.
blocker: The current public BhuNaksha viewer exposed safe native plot identity through ScalarDatahandler and map metadata, but no full parcel polygon or GeoJSON response was obtained. The exact WUP point was outside the tested Katihar(81) cadastral sheet extent; that extent miss is not evidence of citywide absence.
